summary: Transmits CHOP channel data or script commands from TouchDesigner to remote processes or other TouchDesigner Pipe In CHOPs over TCP/IP.
key_concepts: Pipe Out CHOP sends CHOP channel data or one-time script commands over a TCP/IP pipe as either a client or a server.
Multiple Pipe In CHOPs can connect to a single Pipe Out CHOP.
Send Current Sample Only changes whether a non-time-sliced CHOP sends only the current sample or all skipped-frame data since the last cook.
Send All Data uploads all channel names and data once in a burst.
Scripts sent over Pipe Out can execute on the receiving side, so generated plans should only enable script sending for trusted explicit workflows.
Official docs recommend Touch In/Touch Out CHOPs for optimized TouchDesigner-to-TouchDesigner channel transfer and TCP/IP DAT or UDP Out DAT for arbitrary data packets.

common_gotchas: Multiple Pipe In CHOPs can connect to one Pipe Out CHOP.
For TouchDesigner-to-TouchDesigner channel transfer, official docs recommend Touch In/Touch Out CHOPs for optimized time-sliced transfer.
For script commands or arbitrary data packets, official docs prefer TCP/IP DAT or UDP Out DAT.
Scripts sent over Pipe Out can execute on the receiving side; generated plans should avoid this unless explicitly requested and trusted.
When Active is off, data is not sent.
On Windows, firewall settings are a common cause of connection failures.
